name: Shacking Up
overview: Scripture clearly defines the sacred union of marriage as a man leaving his parents to cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh, as emphasized in Genesis 2:24 and reaffirmed in Matthew 19:5. Jesus' acknowledgment of marriage as a distinct covenant underscores the importance of honoring this divine design (John 4:17). Believers are called to resist conforming to worldly patterns and instead renew their minds to discern God's perfect will, avoiding actions that gratify fleshly desires (Romans 12:2; 13:14). Husbands are instructed to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church, highlighting the holiness and commitment expected within marriage (Ephesians 5:25).
